answer_1.quote: The selected tasks not only include understanding tasks but also generation tasks... Specifically, we elaborately tease out 12 dialogue tasks.
answer_1.outputs: Generated responses, summaries, and infilled utterances in dialogue contexts

answer_2.quote: we follow most existing benchmarks to adopt multi-choice questions and use accuracy as the evaluation metric... Specifically, we calculate the perplexity of each option content and then choose the label corresponding to the option content with the lowest perplexity as the predicted answer.

answer_3.quote: we propose to adopt GPT-4 to filter out low-quality instances. We prompt GPT-4 to check whether the multiple-choice questions are correct.
methods: correctness verification of generated evaluation instances
